name: Ignis
description: Ignis runs Obsidian in the browser by reimplementing the Electron APIs Obsidian uses, keeping your vaults on the server. It supports multiple vaults, plugins, file upload/download and sync across browser tabs, so you can access your Obsidian vault from any device without a desktop client.

notes.text: Open https://<IP> and accept the self-signed certificate. HTTPS is required: outside a secure browser context Obsidian's browser APIs (OPFS, service workers) are disabled and the app will not load correctly. nginx terminates TLS and proxies to the Node server on port 8080.
Ignis has NO built-in authentication. Do not expose it directly to the internet - put an authenticating reverse proxy (or VPN) in front of it before allowing remote access.
Vaults and application data live in /opt/ignis_data (vaults, data, obsidian-app), kept outside the app directory so they survive updates. Include /opt/ignis_data in regular backups.
On install the matching Obsidian web build is downloaded and unpacked automatically. A default vault is created on first start (AUTO_CREATE_DEFAULT).
